summary: Bucharest, Romania, programmer, computer science college dropout, strong interest in philosophy and history, particularly Stoicism and Marxism, enjoys cycling, has a wife who works in procurement for a large oil company, experiences mild depression, engaged in personal projects related to local history, critical of corporate practices and government surveillance, values intellectual freedom and self-education, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, has a strong interest in urban planning and architecture, advocates for social justice and equality, familiar with Eastern European socio-political history, expresses concern over the impact of technology on society.
